_comment: Mote ranks and upgrade costs, from an infographic supplied 11 Aug 2026.
Spell XP is 2^(rank-1). Item XP is the rank itself. Both formulas are
stated on the source and both reproduce its printed table exactly, which
is why they are computed here rather than transcribed - a transcription
can carry a typo, a formula that reproduces ten printed rows cannot.
TIER: 3. The artefact is branded by a creator, not by the developers.

rules.eligibility: A mote may be used if its rank equals the item's current tier or is one above it.
rules.conversion: Any two motes combine into one of the next rank.
rules.conversion_cost_to_items: Item XP is the rank, so 2 x rank 5 (10) becomes 1 x rank 6 (6).
rules.void_gems: Three a week from raids. Each advances an item one full rank.
